defensiveAbilities.name: Glow
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

defensiveAbilities.name: Magic Immunity
defensiveAbilities.description: A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except Faerie Fire, Revealing Light, Force Barrage, and Quandary.

offensiveAbilities.name: Aquatic Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
60 feet

See rules...

Requirements The monster is hiding in water and a creature that hasn't detected it is within the listed number of feet.

Effect The monster moves up to its swim Speed + 10 feet toward the triggering creature, traveling on water and on land. Once the creature is in reach, the monster makes a Strike against it. The creature is Off-Guard against this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feed on Fear
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement An enemy is under a fear effect or Dying within 15 feet of the will-o'-wisp.

Effect The will-o'wisp feeds on the creature's terror. It regains 2d4 Healing Damage Hit Points, and if it has Gone Dark, its glow reignites.

A will-o'-wisp can take this action only once per round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Go Dark
offensiveAbilities.description: The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming Invisible. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only Hidden to all observers until it moves.
